_about: T259. A labelled acknowledgement that a committed classification row records a FALSE
predicate under an AFFIRMATIVE verdict, and why that is not being fixed by editing the
evidence. An acknowledgement NEVER silences the checker -- the disagreement is printed on
every run either way. It changes the exit code only.
PINNED TO BYTES. Each block names the sha256 of the file it acknowledges. Edit one byte of
that file and the whole block goes VOID, is reported VOID, and the rows go RED. That is
T114/T176 ('anything that produced COMMITTED EVIDENCE is superseded, NEVER edited in place')
enforced by the instrument instead of by discipline.

acknowledgements.gradedProposition: classify_t229.py's `verdict` is a function of exactly TWO things, re-read from source at HEAD a71c140 (lines beginning `pp = p["predictedTotalPrincipalMinor"]`): the observed OUTCOME family versus `predictedOutcome`, and `observedPrincipalMinor == predictedTotalPrincipalMinor`. Those are precisely the two graded columns of PREDICTION.md section 2's nine-cell table. It therefore means 'THE CELL TABLE ROW HELD' and NOTHING MORE. It does not cover P1..P6, which are computed after it (P2) or not computed at all (P1, P3, P4, P5). The field's name does not say this; nothing in the directory said it before T259.
